dependency_order: A `design-rfc` seeds the problem, constraints, and specialized vocabulary before exact design and risk detail (§4.4).

slots.name: Summary
slots.description: The proposed change, who or what it affects, and the decision reviewers are being asked to make.

slots.name: Context
slots.description: The current condition, problem, and relevant constraints, without decision-path history (§4.9).

slots.name: Requirements
slots.description: Verifiable outcomes and constraints. Distinguish mandatory requirements from preferences.

slots.name: Proposal
slots.description: The design and mechanism, ordered from the assumed-reader view to exact detail.

slots.name: Interfaces and invariants
slots.description: Inputs, outputs, boundaries, compatibility, and properties that must remain true.

slots.name: Alternatives
slots.description: Credible alternatives, including no change when relevant, compared against the requirements.

slots.name: Risks
slots.description: Failure modes, security/reliability concerns, unknowns, and mitigations with bounded claims.

slots.name: Rollout
slots.description: Implementation stages, validation gates, rollback, and ownership or handoff points.

slots.name: Open questions
slots.description: Unresolved decisions and the evidence or owner needed to close each one.
